anchor: The demand path is byte-identical: for the first twelve planner ticks the live and offline planners log the same predicted demand to the second decimal.
claim_text: The demand path is byte-identical for the first twelve planner ticks.

anchor: Tick cadence stretches under stall, with one ~120-second stall in the archived run.
claim_text: Tick cadence stretches under stall, with one ~120-second stall observed in the archived run.

anchor: Three results follow. First, calibrated per-request timing exposes language-pool latency tails that the simulator's default polynomial flattens. Second, the vision pool's cost model admits an exact batching law, grounding a realistic cross-request batching policy and an analytic bound on the inter-pool handoff. Third, and centrally, arrival-speedup sweeps locate each pool's saturation knee: on steady traffic the knees sit an order of magnitude apart.
claim_text: Three main results: (1) calibrated timing reveals language-pool latency tails hidden by polynomial model; (2) vision pool cost model yields exact batching law and analytic handoff bound; (3) arrival-speedup sweeps show saturation knees an order of magnitude apart on steady traffic.

anchor: The vision side needs no such caveat: the ViT and its 4096-dimensional projector output are identical between the 8B and the 235B, so the encoder cost model, batching law, burst-saturation result, and handoff bound all transfer to the flagship unchanged.
claim_text: Vision encoder cost model, batching law, burst-saturation result, handoff bound identical between 8B and 235B models.

anchor: The dispatch cap is not the source of the burst verdict (verified across caps 32/64/128).
claim_text: Dispatch cap not source of burst verdict (verified across caps 32, 64, 128).

anchor: four fields per request: arrival timestamp (millisecond precision), image count, context tokens, and generated tokens
claim_text: Each request has four fields: arrival timestamp with millisecond precision, image count, context tokens, and generated tokens.

anchor: no clean additive decomposition into text and vision tokens exists
claim_text: There is no clean additive decomposition of context tokens into text and vision components.

anchor: clustering the 18 episodes on shape and composition features isolates a single mixed-composition outlier against an otherwise uniform population
claim_text: Clustering the 18 burst episodes on shape and composition features isolates a single mixed-composition outlier; the rest are uniform.
